label: R6 · Your blocks
rationale: Ant-Man's Air Force (2/1 flier) can block either attacker. On Giant-Sized Flying Ant (3/2 flier) it trades your 2-drop for their 4-drop and saves 3. On A.I.M. Scientists (3/3) it dies without killing anything. At 17 life not blocking is also playable, but the chump block on the 3/3 is a clear blunder.
